fixes.explanation: That's it, baker! Verse 7 says, “Though a thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand, no harm will come near you.” Ten thousand! I can't keep track of ten thousand cookies on a cooling rack. Look at where the promise stands: right in the middle of all those numbers, and it doesn't change.

Victory sounds like it would fit, baker, but that's not the word. Verse 8 says, “You will only see it with your eyes and witness the punishment of the wicked.” The word is punishment. It's a heavy verse.

Prophets are a fair guess, but that's not the word here. Verse 11 says, “For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.” The word is angels. And the guarding covers all your ways, not just some of them.

Priests are a fair guess, friend, but they're not in this verse. It says, “For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.” So the ones guarding are angels, and they get their orders from God Himself.
Salvation is the word, baker. The LORD ends the psalm with, “With long life I will satisfy him and show him My salvation.” It's the last thing He says. That's a big note to finish on.
